# langfuse_prompt (Data Source)

Read one version of a prompt. Select it by `version` or by `label`; without either, Langfuse returns the version labelled `production`. Prompt dependencies are resolved in the returned content.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

# Without version or label, the version labelled "production" is read.
data "langfuse_prompt" "support" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "support/answer"
}

data "langfuse_prompt" "staging" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "support/answer"
  label              = "staging"
}

output "support_prompt" {
  value = data.langfuse_prompt.support.prompt
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The prompt name.
- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.

### Optional

- `label` (String) The label of the version to read, for example `production` or `latest`. Conflicts with `version`.
- `version` (Number) The version to read. Conflicts with `label`. Always set to the version that was read.

### Read-Only

- `commit_message` (String) The commit message of the version that was read.
- `config` (String) The prompt config as a JSON value.
- `labels` (Set of String) The labels of the version that was read.
- `prompt` (String) The prompt content. Chat prompts are returned as a JSON-encoded list of messages; decode with `jsondecode`.
- `tags` (Set of String) The tags of the prompt.
- `type` (String) The prompt type: `text` or `chat`.
